title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
summary: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.
body: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.
summaryZh: Stampli在面对紧迫的项目死线时，借助Codex和ChatGPT Work等大模型工具，在设计资源有限的情况下，成功将原本需要数周的发布制作生产周期压缩到了几天内，大幅提升了开发与落地的效率，为企业级AI应用落地提供了典型范例。
